notes: לֹא לָכֶם לְהִלָּחֵם is recast as Ye shall not need to fight: the possessive preposition carries the modal frame and its suffix the subject pronoun, on the pattern rule 43 sets for a possessive preposition heading a verbless clause. The competing reading leaves shall ... need to the infinitive under rule 52 and is named in the unit's note.

still is kept with עִמְדוּ as part of the English phrasal verb rather than marked added; the italic battle is the generic noun supplied to complete the substantival demonstrative and stays in its unit under rule 31.
